Overview

Applied AI & GenAI for Healthcare & Life Sciences earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from EHR integration and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. The Healthcare & Life Sciences operating reality gives this work its shape: clinical reality pressure at event speed, HIPAA / HITECH obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
